dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: ...In the past, I never imagined that even the gods could suffer from hardship.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: If we can find a way to change all of this... will this nation become a better place?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Don't rush. This is a big undertaking, and the planning and preparation for what lies ahead will no doubt take some time.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Take it slowly. We need to make sure the plan is as effective as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's starting to read his book again! Hey! Are you even listening?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Would you like me to lend you something to read?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No way! Your books aren't quite to Paimon's taste...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I was joking. I know my books are far too difficult for you, and I have no intention of lending them out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! You're so annoying...

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: You must let me know if there's anything I can do to help.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: Though I cannot leave Aaru Village, I can't help but feel... stirred when I see the looks in your eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: I've never felt as roused as this when fighting alone in the past...

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: I suppose this must be the power of camaraderie.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: The past few days have been some of the most challenging work I've ever taken on.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: And none of it will earn me a single Mora... I can't believe it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look on the bright side, Dehya! Maybe we'll get a huuuge reward after this is all over!

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Hmm, you've got a point. Hey, what would you do if you woke up tomorrow with more money than you could ever spend?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon would buy boatloads of tasty snacks!

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: That's it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... and maybe some tasty drinks as well?

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Hahaha, how adorable.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Well, here's to all our indulgent fantasies... If there's a chance they can come true, I'll give it my best shot.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: And here's hoping that everything we do from now on will change this world for the better.
